summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Material Fact notice under Chilean Law No. 18,045. The filing discloses that alternate director Alfonso Gómez Morales resigned on September 10, 2026, and the board appointed Javier Maldonado Trinchant as alternate director at a meeting held September 23, 2026. This is a routine board succession item for a foreign private issuer, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure constituting a special situation. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is involved; no risk-arb angle applies.
